contracts: shared lock encloses every request and complete response read
mutation starts spaced at least 1.1 seconds
only explicit secondary 403 or 429 rejection permits retrying a mutation
Retry-After honored with minimum 60 seconds and chunks at most 30 seconds

auth 401/403 and ambiguous mutation outcomes never automatically replayed
existing blobs at most 4 MiB decoded verified by SHA, size, encoding and exact bytes before skipping POST
raw continuation downloads use serialized transport and verify SHA and byte count
primary 403 with remaining zero has distinct reset diagnostic, without waits or mutation replay
